propositions: The reconciler hardcodes status != 'Done' to define the active working set, which fails for client Jira workflows using custom Done-equivalent statuses (Closed, Resolved, Cancelled) because those statuses are not literally 'Done'.
Issues in custom Done-equivalent statuses are incorrectly pulled into the active working set and treated as active, causing the reconciler to push outbound mutations at resolved issues.
The jql_done_recent query misses issues in custom Done-equivalent statuses, so they never populate the recent-Done snapshot.

Switch the Done predicate from literal 'status = Done' to Jira's workflow-agnostic 'statusCategory = Done' and 'statusCategory != Done' to correctly scope active/done sets regardless of custom workflow statuses.
All Jira statuses, including custom Closed/Resolved/Cancelled, map to one of the standard status categories (To Do, In Progress, Done), which statusCategory predicates correctly identify.
DIG/REB workflows (To Do/In Progress/Done only) retain identical behavior; single- and multi-project fan-out scoping is unchanged except for the predicate switch.
